Lessons.Title: Tangent
ExplanationParagraphs: Source-aligned goals: Compare and contrast (in writing) the features of the cosine, sine, and tangent functions. Describe (orally and in writing) features of the graph of the tangent function, such as period, domain, and asymptotes.
Tangent θ=sinθ/cosθ has periodπ and domain excluding θ=π/2+kπ. It is unbounded on intervals between vertical asymptotes, unlike sine and cosine.

Source activity 12.3: The Tangent Function: Before we graph \(y= \tan(\theta)\), let’s figure out some things that must be true. Explain why the graph of \(\tan(\theta)\) has a vertical asymptote at \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\). Does the graph of \(\tan(\theta)\) have other vertical asymptotes? Explain how you know. For which values of \(\theta\) is \(\tan(\theta)\) zero? For which values of \(\theta\) is \(\tan(\theta)\) one?… Explain the mathematical model, verify the relevant result and have a teacher inspect original diagrams or discussion evidence.
